whenToUse: A single-page app is loading data for the next screen.
People wait without the current screen being cleared.
Most transitions finish within one or two seconds.
whenNotToUse: Only part of the screen reloads (use a skeleton or spinner).
Progress is known exactly (use a progress bar).
Tasks taking more than a few seconds (use a progress toast).

alternatives.name: Skeleton
alternatives.reason: Drawing the new screen's space first.

accessibility: The bar is a named progressbar, and aria-hidden when not visible.
Put aria-busy on the loading area to say it's changing.
It appears only after a short delay, so fast transitions don't flicker.
Motion uses only transform, and transitions turn off with reduced motion.
